You are carrying the chairs into the garden now.
You always remember your mother's birthday.

q: هِيَ ___ دَائِمًا عِنْدَمَا تُشَاهِدُ الْأَفْلَامَ الْحَزِينَةَ.
e: She always cries when she watches sad films.

q: ___ أَبِي مَفَاتِيحَهُ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُلَّ مَسَاءٍ.
e: My father puts his keys on the table every evening.
The girls visit their grandmother every Friday.

q: أَنَا ___ مِنَ الْحَافِلَةِ قُرْبَ بَيْتِي كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
e: I get off the bus near my house every day.
You two work for the same company now.
The two boys play football every day.

q: الْبِنْتَانِ ___ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ مَعًا كُلَّ صَبَاحٍ.
e: The two girls go to school together every morning.
You two speak Arabic well now.
My two brothers live in Paris now.
The two sisters cook together every evening.
You two always drink coffee without sugar.
The two students study in the library every evening.

q: الْمُعَلِّمَتَانِ ___ الطُّلَّابَ الضُّعَفَاءَ بَعْدَ الدَّرْسِ دَائِمًا.
e: The two teachers (f) always help the weak students after class.
You two visit your grandfather every week.
The two friends run in the park every morning.
The two little girls sing with their mother every morning.
You two wait for the bus here every morning.
The two men are carrying the heavy box now.
The two nurses work at the hospital every night.
This usually happens in winter.

q: هِيَ ___ فِي الْبَيْتِ يَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ عَادَةً.
e: She usually stays at home on Sunday.
It always gets cold at night.
Children get taller every year.
I promise my children a present every Eid.
You are always afraid of dogs.
We always dream of a house by the sea.
You always choose the same restaurant.
They always decide everything together.
You take part in the competition every year.
The meeting usually goes on for two hours.
The bus stops here every ten minutes.

q: الطَّالِبَاتُ ___ إِلَى سَكَنٍ جَدِيدٍ كُلَّ سَنَةٍ.
e: The (female) students move to a new residence every year.
The weather always changes quickly in spring.
I change my password every month.
You are always losing your keys.
You earn a lot of money now.
They always win the big matches.

q: ___ هٰذَا الْمُمَثِّلُ فِي التِّلْفَازِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
e: This actor appears on television every day.
Now I believe that you are right.
The manager (f) always confirms appointments a day ahead.
You fill the bottle with water every morning.
The students memorise a new poem every week.
We care a lot about the environment now.

q: أَنْتَ ___ دَائِمًا أَنْ تُسَافِرَ إِلَى الْيَابَانِ.
e: You always wish you could travel to Japan.
This boy is always hitting his little brother.
The school always bans phones in class.
The parents always welcome the guests at the door.
The two girls always stand in the front row.
You two collect old stamps now.
You always explain the lesson to your classmates.
You always reply to my messages quickly.

q: أَنَا الْآنَ ___ هٰذَا الْكِتَابَ أَهَمَّ كِتَابٍ فِي حَيَاتِي.
e: I now consider this book the most important book in my life.
They always admit their mistakes.

q: أَنْتَ ___ أَفْكَارًا جَدِيدَةً فِي كُلِّ اجْتِمَاعٍ.
e: You suggest new ideas at every meeting.
She always expects the worst.
You always deal with customers kindly.

q: نَحْنُ ___ كَثِيرًا مِنْ هٰذِهِ الدُّرُوسِ الْآنَ.
e: We are getting a lot out of these lessons now.
The two ministers are discussing the problem in the meeting now.

q: ___ أَبِي الْحَرَّ فِي الصَّيْفِ بِصُعُوبَةٍ دَائِمًا.
e: My father always finds the summer heat hard to bear.
You always avoid spicy food.
Now you realise how important time is.
The teachers (f) always notice every small mistake.
A child discovers something new every day.

q: ___ الْأَخْبَارُ بِسُرْعَةٍ فِي الْقُرَى الصَّغِيرَةِ دَائِمًا.
e: News always spreads quickly in small villages.
Science is developing very fast these days.
The engineers are developing a new program now.
I always express my opinion frankly.
You apologise for being late every day.
We always agree with your opinion.
She always refuses help.

q: الطُّلَّابُ ___ فِي شَهْرِ يُونْيُو كُلَّ سَنَةٍ.
e: Students graduate in June every year.
